name: Vaneform API
description: Read website intelligence through HTTP or MCP. Free and Pro keys can call the API. Free includes 100 credits per UTC month, Pro 10,000. A domain read spends 1 credit; bulk and TLD spend 1 credit per compared domain with data. Keyword lookup (60 credits) and include=search (200 credits) are Pro-only; a Free key gets 403 pro_required or search_requires_pro with an upgrade_url. Each key allows 60 requests a minute and 5,000 a day; over that returns 429 lookup_rate_exceeded with Retry-After. include=search uses a 24-hour receipt. A keyword repeat is free when the saved brief is ready or empty. Every estimate keeps as_of and confidence. The human guide is available at /docs/api.
